stories.title: Kash Patel's fiancée: "Went and got the law involved"
stories.summary: FBI Director Kash Patel got engaged to country singer Alexis Wilkins, and she announced it with a photo of the ring captioned "Went and got the law involved 💍❤️" (45K likes, 6.5K replies). The replies split between congratulations and jokes about the couple, and Sean McCarthy's mocking quote post (36K) nearly matched the announcement itself.
